question: What was the first image of a black hole?
short_answer: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) released the first direct image of a black hole's shadow in the galaxy Messier 87 (M87*) on April 10, 2019.
full_explanation: Using radio observatories spread across Earth to form a planet-sized virtual telescope, astronomers captured photon ring emission bending around the 6.5-billion-solar-mass black hole.
